review_candidates.title: Paralegal
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Paralegal Job Category: Service Contract Act Time Type: Full time Minimum Clearance Required to Start: DOJ MBI Employee Type: Regular Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25% Type of Travel: Continental US * * * The Opportunity CACI is seeking a Paralegal (Legal Assistant I) to support the Department of Justice’s mission. This position plays a critical role and involves working on high-profile cases. We are looking for candidates who are able to work in an office setting. Paralegal duties focus on litigation support and preparation for upcoming trials. This is an opportunity for you to provide case management and database maintenance assistance in a litigation support capacity. You will also gain invaluable experience using automated litigation support and eDiscovery tools and resources to add to your skillset. You will also be exposed to fast-paced, high-profile, and impactful individual and corporate cases that span the globe. The Paralegal (Legal Assistant I) role works closely with federal prosecutors supporting the Department’s Foreign Corrupt Practices Act Unit, a specialized group of prosecutors who work to combat foreign bribery and corruption. You’ll work in a fast-paced setting and assist in the investigation and prosecution of various matters to enforce the laws of the United States, up to and including support assistance for witness interviews, deposition preparation, and in-courtroom trial support. CACI is committed to growing our eDiscovery workforce and has included tuition reimbursement for Relativity certifications, the ACEDS certification and Paralegal Certificates! This is a great opportunity to grow your career. Please apply if you are interested in hearing more! Responsibilities The Paralegal works under the direction of Supervisory Paralegal. In this role, you will perform litigation services while complying with established procedures, including but not limited to the following: Indexes, tracks and controls document discovery (including documents produced and received in discovery). Compiles, prepares, and summarizes relevant materials for use by attorneys in discovery and in preparation of motions, briefs and other legal documents. Summarizes depositions and other transcripts; maintains case files and performs simple legal research. Indexes and tracks exhibits and other material at depositions and at trial. Prepares exhibit cross-references. Assists attorneys in courtroom. Reviews documents for relevance and privilege according to established guidelines and criteria. Other examples of the types of work to be performed include compilation of documents for FOIA, production requests, Congressional inquiries, etc. Qualifications Required: Fluency in Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, French, Arabic, Hindi, Italian, German, or Dutch. The ability to read and understand the documents in one of the referenced languages and summarize the contents. No heavy translation or interpretation will be required. Four-year college degree. Paralegal certificate or an equivalent level of legal training or experience. Additionally, at least one year of litigation paralegal experience or project experience (including internships) related to business, finance or accounting, project or document management, policy, research, government staffing, publishing; or equivalent experience. Requires excellent written and oral communication skills, thorough knowledge and hands-on familiarity with a variety of computer applications, including word processing, databases (such as document review and file management systems), spreadsheets, imaging, and hardware systems. Requires technological proficiency in Microsoft Suites (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Must have an understanding on how electronically stored information (computer files) work within an operating system including experience effectively managing, organizing, and analyzing digital files and folders. Transferable skills related to Electronically Stored Information (ESI) tools and eDiscovery procedures and resources. Ability to consistently deliver highest quality work under extreme pressure will be very important. DOJ MBI must be obtainable (US Citizenship required). Desired Automated litigation support experience. Document review and Relativity experience. What You Can Expect A culture of integrity. At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation. An environment of trust. CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. Pay Range This posting is for a position covered by the Service Contract Labor Standards (SCA). The pay and benefits provided for this position will meet or exceed the minimum required amounts detailed in the wage determination issued by the Department of Labor and made applicable to this position, as incorporated into CACI’s government contract for the work location. Minimum Required Hourly Wage $25.58 There are a host of other factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographical location, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits. CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

review_candidates.description: Introtekst Wil jij werken in de spannende wereld van IT en de Militaire Politie? Als Onderofficier Informatievoorziening & Communicatie- en Informatiesystemen (IV&CIS) bij de Marechaussee gebruik je jouw ICT-skills elke dag. Je zorgt ervoor dat systemen goed werken en helpt mee aan vrede en veiligheid, in Nederland én daarbuiten. Let op: Dit is een functie als ICT-medewerker in de rang van Wachtmeester. Je gaat dus niet de straat op om boeven te vangen. Je werkt vooral met ICT en helpt de organisatie met technische taken. Voldoe je aan de eisen en solliciteer je? Dan krijg je een uitnodiging voor een voorlichting. Deze bijeenkomst is verplicht. Dit ga je doen Als onderofficier IV&CIS bij de Marechaussee werk je in Nederland en soms in het buitenland. De Marechaussee heeft veel verschillende taken, zoals grensbewaking, beveiliging en (militaire) politietaken. Soms help je ook bij nationale noodsituaties. Ben je flexibel en neem je graag verantwoordelijkheid? Dan is deze afwisselende baan iets voor jou! Je krijgt een dubbele opleiding: tot onderofficier Transmissie en netwerkbeheerder. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze moderne communicatieapparatuur altijd goed werkt. Zonder jou kunnen eenheden, de meldkamer en het operatiecentrum niet goed met elkaar communiceren. Samen met je team zorg je ervoor dat alle IT-netwerken soepel draaien. Je werkt niet alleen met computers en radiosystemen, maar ook met netwerkapparatuur. Daarnaast richt je verschillende operationele ICT-netwerken in en beheer je ze. Jij bent de spin in het web en zorgt ervoor dat elke missie of operatie slaagt. Werksfeer: nergens maak je deel uit van zo’n hecht team van collega’s als bij Defensie. Doorgroeimogelijkheden: Defensie is naast werkgever ook een groot opleidingsinstituut, waar je (betaald) opleidingen kunt volgen om persoonlijk en professioneel te groeien. Uitdaging: Je hebt veel verantwoordelijkheid en vrijheid in je werk en: geen dag is hetzelfde! Hier ga je werken Je gaat werken in Huis ter Heide, de thuisbasis van CIS KMar. Je kunt aan de slag bij CIS van het Landelijk Tactisch Commando, de Brigade Speciale Beveiligingsopdrachten of bij 101 Marechaussee Bataljon. Voordat je begint als onderofficier ICT, volg je eerst een opleiding. Je start met de Onderofficiersopleiding Bedrijfsvoering bij het Opleidings-, Trainings- en Kenniscentrum van de Koninklijke Marechaussee (OTCKMar) in Apeldoorn. Tijdens deze periode slaap je op de kazerne. Daarna volg je een leidinggevende module van 2 weken. Hierin leer je hoe je een team aanstuurt. Vervolgens start de vakopleiding tot Onderofficier Transmissie en Netwerkbeheerder. Deze opleiding is modern en praktijkgericht. Daarna kun je je verder specialiseren met extra IT-opleidingen. Heb je alles afgerond? Dan ben jij een echte KMar IT-specialist! Opmerking: heb je nog geen zwemdiploma? Dan kun je toch solliciteren! We gaan dan samen met jou bekijken of je dat zwemdiploma vóór jouw aanstelling kunt halen. En het mooie is: de kosten voor het behalen van een zwemdiploma worden dan door Defensie vergoed! Wij niet. We zien niet alleen wie je nu bent maar ook wie je kunt worden. Wat je vandaag nog niet kunt leer je morgen. Met goede opleiding, training, begeleiding en een team dat achter je staat. Zet de stap Sollicitatie procesHoe bereid ik me voor? Geen zorgen, wij geloven in jou. Bij Defensie krijg je alles wat je nodig hebt om te groeien: goede opleidingen, trainingen, coaching én een team dat achter je staat. Lukt het toch niet? Dan helpen we je verder. review_candidates.title: ITIL Specialist
review_candidates.description: Why You’ll Love Softchoice At Softchoice, a World Wide Technology (WWT) company, we work together to make a new world happen. As an IT solutions provider serving U.S. commercial and SMB organizations, as well as the entire Canadian market, we help organizations turn ambition into real‑world outcomes. We do this through the delivery of secure cloud, AI, software and digital workplace solutions that enable agility, innovation and growth. With a highly engaged, high-performing team, we are certified as a Great Place to Work® in both Canada and the United States, and have been recognized as a Best Workplace in Canada for more than 20 years. We stand proudly for our people and their success through career development and advancement, and continuously strive to do what’s good for our people and communities. As part of WWT, we connect customers to the global scale, advanced innovation, world-class partnerships, and deep expertise of a leader in AI and digital transformation. This includes access to WWT’s Advanced Technology Center (ATC), a collaborative ecosystem featuring state-of-the-art hardware and software that enables customers and partners to conceptualize, test, and validate innovative solutions before deploying them at scale. The Impact You Will Have As Managed Services Operations expands into an enterprise-scale ITSM mandate, we need a dedicated practitioner who can drive governance, performance visibility, and continual improvement across our core service management practices. The ITIL Specialist role is anchored in governance, analytics, and continual service improvement. You will own the KPI and SLA visibility layer for Incident Management & Request Fulfillment, drive CSI initiatives across all ITSM practices, and ensure the operating model stays disciplined and measurable as scope grows. This is a practitioner-level position for someone with deep ITIL knowledge and the analytical capability to translate operational data into structured improvement programs. You will work alongside the existing Service Management Excellence Office team complementing the facilitation and practice delivery work already underway. What You'll Do ITSM governance and practice ownership Own the governance framework for Incident Management, Request Fulfillment, and Service Level Management defining practice standards, operating procedures, escalation thresholds, and compliance checkpoints. Serve as the ITSM practice authority within Service Management Team providing guidance to ITSM Administrators, Technical Delivery engineers, and Platform Engineers on process adherence and best practice application. Maintain and publish the ITSM Practice Framework documentation capturing current operating standards, practice ownership assignments, and process interdependencies across the full ITSM scope. Lead the quarterly ITSM practice review cycle assessing process conformance, surfacing gaps, and driving alignment across Managed Services, Operations Engineering, and Customer Success. Define and enforce escalation criteria, priority matrices, and SLA breach protocols across all governed practices ensuring consistent application across teams and customer environments. Act as the ITSM governance point of contact for audit, compliance, and regulatory requirements that intersect with service management operations. KPI, SLA, and performance analytics Own the KPI and SLA performance visibility layer for Service Management governance by defining metrics, building reporting frameworks, and maintaining dashboards that reflect practice health across all governed areas. Produce regular operational performance reports for leadership and stakeholder audiences by translating metric data into business-relevant insight on service quality, SLA compliance, and practice maturity. Monitor leading and lagging indicators across Incident, Request, and SLM practices by identifying performance trends, capacity signals, and process adherence issues before they become incidents or breaches. Conduct variance analysis on SLA performance investigating breach patterns, identifying root contributors (people, process, or system), and driving structured remediation. Maintain a CSI metrics register that tracks the outcome of improvement initiatives over time demonstrating measurable impact on practice performance. Partner with Service Delivery Managers and Customer Success teams to ensure customer-facing SLA reporting is accurate, consistent, and aligned to contractual obligations. Continual service improvement (CSI) Lead the ITSM Continual Service Improvement program identifying, scoping, and driving improvement initiatives across all governed practices. Conduct structured problem analysis and trend reviews across recurring incident patterns, SLA breaches, and process exceptions translating findings into prioritized improvement actions. Facilitate post-incident reviews for major incidents and high-impact SLA failures ensuring improvement actions are captured, assigned, and tracked to resolution. Drive process optimization initiatives that reduce operational friction, improve ticket quality, reduce mean time to resolve (MTTR), and improve SLA attainment. Maintain a structured CSI register and report on improvement initiative status, outcomes, and value delivered on a quarterly basis. Champion ITSM best practice adoption across the broader Managed Services organization by coaching practitioners on process conformance and driving cultural alignment with ITIL principles. Tooling and workflow governance Own the ITSM workflow configuration governance layer in ServiceNow ensuring platform configurations reflect current process standards and that changes to workflows are reviewed, approved, and documented. Partner with ITSM Administrators on platform changes that affect governed practices providing process requirements, impact assessment, and post-implementation validation. Identify tooling gaps that create process friction or data quality issues, and drive resolution through configuration changes, enhancements, or integration improvements. Maintain a tooling configuration baseline for governed practice areas ensuring platform state is documented and aligned to approved operating standards. Stakeholder engagement and practice enablement Lead structured stakeholder engagements across Managed Services, Technical delivery, and Customer Success to socialize practice standards, collect process feedback, and drive adoption of governance updates. Deliver ITSM practice enablement sessions for new and existing team members, covering process standards, escalation procedures, and tooling workflows. Represent the team in cross-functional working groups, change advisory board (CAB) sessions, and operational review meetings as the ITSM governance voice. Provide mentorship and guidance to junior ITSM practitioners on process conformance, escalation handling, and best practice application. What You'll Bring To The Table Required experience and qualifications 5+ years of experience in ITSM governance, service management operations, or IT process management within a managed services or enterprise IT environment. ITIL 4 Foundation certification required; ITIL 4 Managing Professionals or ITIL 4 Practice Manager or ITIL 4 Specialist: Drive Stakeholder Value / High Velocity IT strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience owning ITSM governance frameworks specifically Incident Management, Request Fulfillment, and Service Level Management, at a practitioner level. Strong analytical capability: able to build KPI frameworks, interpret metric trends, conduct variance analysis, and communicate performance insight to leadership audiences. Proven experience leading Continual Service Improvement program, including defining improvement initiatives, tracking outcomes, and demonstrating measurable impact. Hands-on familiarity with ITSM platforms specifically ServiceNow, including workflow configuration, reporting, and SLA management modules. Excellent communication and facilitation skills: able to lead governance reviews, present to leadership, and drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience in a Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment with direct exposure to multi-customer ITSM operations and customer-facing SLA governance. Familiarity with CMDB, Problem Management, Change Management, and Configuration Management at a practitioner level: understanding cross-practice dependencies. Experience building or maturing ITSM practice frameworks in a post-merger or portfolio consolidation context. Exposure to ITSM tooling administration: ServiceNow platform configuration and workflow design is an asset. Post-secondary education in Information Technology, Business Technology Management, or a related discipline. Fluency in French an asset. Compensation A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position in Canada is $76,550 to $102,000, annually + 10% as target incentives. Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, education, and related certification. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Softchoice offers a comprehensive and competitive benefit plan to all full-time employees, which includes: Health and Wellbeing: Medical and Dental Care, Employee & Family Assistance Program Financial Benefits: RRSP/DPSP Retirement Savings Plan with Company Matching, Life and Disability Insurance Paid Time Off: Vacation and Sick Leave, Holidays, Parental Leave, Volunteer Days, Bereavement Leave Additional Perks: Employee Discount Program Not sure if you qualify? Think about applying anyway: We understand that not everyone brings 100% of the skills and experience for the role. At Softchoice, we offer opportunities to a diverse group including those with a variety of workplace experiences and backgrounds. Whether you are new to corporate tech, returning to work after a gap in employment, or looking to transition and take the next step in your career, we are excited to learn more about you and encourage you to apply. Why You’ll Love Working Here The People: You’ll thrive in our collaborative environment, surrounded by incredible colleagues who foster support and innovation, driving our collective success High-Performing Culture: At Softchoice, we are dedicated to achieving our goals and committed to success for our customers and each other Flexibility: Plan your workdays in a way that suits you best Award-Winning Workplace: Proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work for 21 consecutive years Inclusive Culture: We are committed to a company culture where every team member can be their authentic self Competitive Benefits: Benefit from competitive perks that start on day one Inclusion & Equal Opportunity Employment We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion & belonging . People seeking employment at Softchoice are considered without regard to any protected category including but not limited to, race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Require accommodation? We are ready to help: We are proud to provide interview & employment accommodation during the recruitment and hiring process. If you require any accommodation to apply or interview for a position, please reach out directly to asktalentacquisition@softchoice.com . We are committed to working with you to best meet your needs. Our Commitment To Your Experience We are committed to the safety of all applicants and team members. With that in mind, we have implemented digital interviewing for everyone. We understand that you may need to interview with distractions around you (such as children or furry friends) and we will be doing the same. Before you start with us, we will conduct a criminal record check, verify your education, and check your references. When you join Softchoice, we will onboard you remotely. Don't worry. It's quick, simple and you'll be connected with your new team in no time. Job Requisition ID: 7654 EoE/M/F/Vet/Disability
